result:
**QA-23894: PASS.** The five LinkedIn Best Performing Content posts on Brand Insights match the first five rows on Brand Content exactly, and the post counts match too. This was UCLA, Last 30 Days (Sep 19 – Oct 18, 2026), LinkedIn only.

- **Counts and metrics:** Insights shows 133 new posts and Content shows `Posts (133)`. Engagements, Reactions, Shares and Comments match for all five posts.
- **Video Views:** the two video posts show "–" for Video Views on Content's default Public data set but 20,106 and 8,920 on the Insights tile. The app says LinkedIn Video Views are Authorized-only and live in the Video Views data set. Switching to that data set gives the same two numbers, so this is by design, not a defect.
- **Brand:** the brand typeahead has no brand named exactly "UCLA". I used `University of California, Los Angeles`, the UCLA account's own brand, as sibling cases do.
- **Known bugs:** none were open or relevant.

The report is at `results/2026-10-20/QA-23894-report.md`, and screenshots are in `.playwright-out/QA-23894/`.
